summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Trading Journal (TradeZella) app with real-time features. Backend: 19/19 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All core flows working - login, signup, dashboard, live market ticker, live price chart, add trade, logout.

minor.issue: Was returning 500 when no onboarding exists - FIXED by making created_at/updated_at optional in schema

integration_issues.issue: WebSocket connection shows intermittent 'closed before established' errors in console, but REST API fallback works and prices load correctly

issues: Console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' - Recharts sizing issue on initial render, resolves after data loads
Console error: 'The given origin is not allowed for the given client ID' - Google OAuth not configured for this preview domain

action_items: WebSocket connection is intermittent - may need to investigate Kubernetes ingress WebSocket support or add connection retry logic
Google OAuth needs domain configuration for preview environment
Recharts sizing warning could be fixed by adding explicit dimensions or minWidth/minHeight
critical_code_review_comments: UserOnboardingResponse schema required created_at/updated_at but default response didn't include them - fixed
Trade quantity field expects integer, not float - may want to support decimal quantities for crypto trading
Frontend TypeScript errors in Reports/Charts components (Tooltip formatter types) - pre-existing issue noted by main agent

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all core flows working, minor WebSocket intermittency)

seed_data_creation: Test user already exists in database
